contexts.text: There was a strife between the shepherds of Abram's cattle, and the shepherds of Lot's cattle () = that the internal man and the external did not agree.
They who are not in charity, dispute about everything.
As he who disputes whether...
The simple... can perceive... without any dispute...
From the long continued dispute about the circulation of the blood... From the dispute about the sun... And also from the dispute about the soul...

When men strive together () = contention among themselves about truths... Hence the strife of the men = contention about truths among those who are of the Church... For in the spiritual sense to strive together = to contend about such things as are of the Church... That in the Word to strive together = contention about truths, in general, in favour of truths against falsities; and also defence, and deliverance from falsities. Illustrated.
The controversy of Jehovah against the nations () = the contention of the Lord in favour of truths against falsities, and in favour of goods against evils; thus, also, defence.
To plead their suit () = to defend against falsities, and to deliver.
To plead the suit of the soul () = to defend and to deliver from falsities.
To plead the cause () = to deliver from falsities.
To plead with the mountains () = to contend and defend against the haughty.
There are two disputes which have infested the Church from the earliest times...

Thou shalt not answer upon a cause to decline after many to pervert () = no consociation with those who turn goods and truths into evils and falsities, and the reverse. To answer upon a cause = concerning what is just and fair, and what is good and true, about which there is a contention.
Thou shalt not revere a poor man in his cause () = that we are not to favour the falsities in which are they who are in ignorance of truth.
A cause = the contention of truth against falsity, and of falsity against truth.

Thou shalt not decline the judgment of thy needy in his cause () = no destruction of a little truth with those who are in ignorance... A cause = contention; here, in the cause = in his own cause about a little truth for which he is contending.
Matters of judgment never come into dispute there; but matters of justice.
There arose a dispute among Spirits...
Under Dispute, see this reference.
They continually love disputes...
The strife of tongues () = the falsity of evil.
The controversy of Zion ().
The strife of tongues = the falsity of religion from which they reason against truths.
Because the controversy of Jehovah is against the nations = visitation upon all who are in evils. ( = visitation and detection. AE 659:22.)
To plead the suit = visitation and judgment.
